title: Stu B NDE 5145/4075
content:
5145 I had slipped and fallen into the deep end of a swimming pool. I sank to the bottom and remained there, undetected for a while, until a man saw me. My experience included a journey and a purpose. I clearly remember a tunnel and a vacuum sucking me back when it was time to return. I wanted to fight it and continue the journey, but was unable to do so. I spiraled and was sucked back into my body; back to the discomfort, pain and fear, which had been non-existent for quite a while. I was later told that I had no pulse for ‘some time’ and the man who found me spent a while with me, refusing to give up. I was badly bruised and damaged as he had beaten my chest with some force to revive me. I experienced anger and sadness at having to return to this life. My mother became over-protective of me and I turned into a very nervous child. I returned from my near death experience (NDE) with heightened sensitivity on many levels. I was able to remote view and had acquired extra-sensory perception (ESP). My IQ soared and I was tested at school frequently, to the point where I began to wonder if there was something seriously wrong with me. I was especially nervous when some men in suits came to our home to try to convince my parents to allow me to go to their academy. I was worried about being taken away. My parents would not allow it. As the years went by, I came to accept my extra sensory abilities with the help of some psychics and clairvoyants. They were the only ones I could comfortably turn to without judgment or apprehension. They tried to convince me to ‘develop’ the gifts I had to help others. I decided I could not deal with that kind of thing emotionally and chose not to pursue it. I wanted to have as much of a ‘normal’ life as I could with my family and friends.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) Drowning in a swimming pool. | Yes Accident drowning in a hotel swimming pool 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I slipped while running and fell into a swimming pool at a hotel and drowned. I lay at the bottom of pool for a time until a man found me and revived me.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Boundary
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I do not remember. Time did not exist there. | I do not remember this. I clearly remember the wonderful bliss as I moved in a vortex toward a very bright light and looked down from above the water and saw myself laying spread on the floor of the pool as I turned around and went back to the color blobs and through the tunnel toward the beautiful light. I believe that after a while there was an abrupt feeling of being sucked back. And the pain and misery set in as I was being jumped on and slapped by a man who was trying to revive me. I wanted to go back. I was so young but the few conscious memories I have are still vivid in my mind like it happened yesterday.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I sensed it but had no desire to understand it or comprehend any of it. I felt total acceptance for a while.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I do not remember this. | I looked down at my body lying at the bottom of the pool.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was like a huge vacuum cleaner. A feeling of spiraling and swirling in slow motion until I realized I had to return. Then the vacuum became intense and fast. I returned quickly and directly into the upper part of my chest area. I felt the pain immediately. | Yes I was entering into a tunnel, a kind of vortex toward a wonderful light.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: No There was no other people or beings, or Jesus, or God there. But I knew that they would be coming eventually.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I was not immediately surrounded by it but felt drawn towards it. I knew without a doubt that I was supposed to go there.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Quickly went from black gray to beautiful colors which continued to intensify. | A clearly mystical or unearthly realm flashing blobs of colors during the trip toward the light.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Extreme joy in the experience of the journey, and purpose (whatever it was to be), but nothing when I returned to witness the event from another place. Nothing in the reality of the physical incident mattered to me in any way, with the exception of a brief moment, when I saw my mother's frantic reaction after being pulled out of the water. | I do not remember. I only remember extreme pleasure and bliss beyond words.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I do not remember.
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Yes There was a sudden realization that I could not continue on the journey. I was quickly forced into a reverse vacuum tunnel without time to think about it. I knew I was returning to my body. I did not question it, but became angry when the pain started; I just wanted to go back.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I am unable to answer this specifically. I would say I am more ‘spiritual’. I also believe there is a reason and purpose for everything. | No
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist 'Not sure...spiritual I suppose. I do believe in God, a higher power that has ultimate control over everything.' | Conservative/fundamentalist Unsure
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I am unable to answer this specifically. I would say I am more ‘spiritual’. I also believe there is a reason and purpose for everything. | No
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I cannot explain. | Yes Several years later when strange things began to occur in my life.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: No I have a loving and understanding family.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No I have a loving and understanding family. After the NDE | tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain It depends on who I choose to talk to about it. | No
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I did not want to return and was angry when I could feel the pain and I could not complete the journey. I will never fear physical death. | Not until a few years ago. Then I realized the connections associated with the experience and later strange personal experiences.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My parents who were very worried. My wife and children learned to accept my strange abilities. I have always been careful with whom I share anything and have kept it mostly to myself. People cannot deal with it. | Yes Thankfully I have a tolerant and understanding wife and children. I have only shared these experiences with them and 2 psychics, and my mother through my life.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Even at a young age, I realized the significance of the experience and was changed as a person forever by it. | Experience was probably real I was too young to seriously think about it. It came clear to me later in life. But it seriously affected my entire life and I now realize this.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real It was not until later in life when I came to a realization that the NDE was responsible for all the other strange things I have experienced and endured throughout my life. I truly believe it is all connected. I returned with heightened sensitivity and purpose. | Experience was definitely real I recently began to read a couple of books that my son purchased and after all these years, I finally can associate the connections. It all makes sense to me now.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I have a complete understanding of a few aspects of life and the afterlife. But many other questions which I am sure will not be answered in this life. I try not to dwell on it all too much. But there are phases when certain events become a little overwhelming, so I seek the advice and company of a psychic / clairvoyant, and talk with my wife. | ? Not being able to completely open up to anyone about the experience for many years is the most difficult aspect of it. Only someone who has experienced it can relate; and I have never met another person who has. But I have not seriously looked for anyone. Perhaps I am now by finding this site.
